slides.title: Our business license reminder was a coaster
slides.body: The renewal notice sat under a coffee mug. It was due last Friday.

slides.title: Mail is not a tracking system
slides.body: Renewal notices get buried, lost or sent to an old address. Some never arrive at all.

slides.title: Put every expiration in one place
slides.body: Licenses, permits, insurance policies, certifications: one list, with dates, and a reminder well before each one.

slides.title: Retire the coaster system
slides.body: CertTrack tracks every license, permit and policy and alerts you before anything expires.
